name: Atlantic hurricanes
summary: No active Atlantic storms; low south of Bermuda has a 50% chance of forming, moving east
state: The National Hurricane Center showed no active Atlantic systems at 01:00 EST on 5 Nov. A non-tropical low a few hundred miles south of Bermuda has a 30% chance of development in 48 hours and 50% in seven days, and is moving slowly east over open ocean before conditions turn unfavourable (NHC). The season ends on 30 Nov.
for_you: No Atlantic storm threatens land as of 5 Nov. Travellers to the Caribbean and Bermuda can follow NHC outlooks.
rubric_hit: No storm threatening land within 5 days (NHC) = Normal

sources.title: NOAA NHC — Graphical Tropical Weather Outlook, Atlantic

why: Atlantic hurricanes hit the US Gulf coast, Caribbean and Central America — and refinery and insurance markets with them.
drivers: Sea-surface temperatures, ENSO, wind shear, season timing (Jun–Nov peak Aug–Oct).

rubric.alert: Category 3+ landfall expected within 72 hours or occurring.
rubric.watch: Tropical storm or hurricane threatening land within 5 days.
rubric.normal: No hurricane active, or none threatening land within 5 days.
